article.story: HAMMOND, La. -- — Jakevion Buckley scored 25 points as Southeast Louisiana beat UT Rio Grande Valley 79-75 on Monday night. Buckley added three steals for the Lions (7-8, 1/3 Southland Conference). Jeremy Elyzee scored 16 points, going 7 of 10 from the field. Sam Hines Jr. finished 6 of 13 from the floor and scored 14. The Vaqueros (10-5, 2-2) were led by Cliff Davis with 14 points. K.T. Raimey added 13 points. Hasan Abdul-Hakim finished with 11 points and seven rebounds. The Vaqueros saw a five-game win streak end. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
